caption: I work in food and I was still paying for a meal kit I cancelled over a year ago. What's hiding in your statement?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R33 000
p/m salary
Living in Vredenburg
slides.body:
Female, 32
Single, no kids
Job: Chef at a West Coast restaurant
Net salary: R33 000 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.body: I picked this place for the view. Worth it, mostly.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: I cook all day at work and still buy takeaways at home
slides.body: Chefs apparently don't cook for themselves. Who knew.

slides.title: Forgotten subscriptions
slides.includes: Two streaming services I don't watch, a cancelled meal kit still billing me, a gym I haven't been to since March
slides.body: I found this by accident going through three months of statements. It's been happening for over a year.

slides.title: Bank fees & interest
slides.includes: Monthly account fee, one card that's never fully paid off
slides.body: Small enough to ignore every single month. Big enough to notice over a year.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Medical aid, retirement annuity, cellphone & fibre, funeral policy, stokvel, eating out at other people's restaurants on my day off
slides.body: This is the responsible half of the budget. It just doesn't feel as satisfying to talk about.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R33 000. Before I found the subscriptions, I would have told you this number was smaller.

slides.title: The leaks were the real story
slides.body:
Beyond Horizon flagged three charges I didn't recognise the first week I uploaded a statement — two of them turned out to be the cancelled meal kit still billing me.

R1 450 a month I wasn't even using.

No bank login needed.
